column4: The other particle entries in this set (的, 了, 吗, 呢, 得, 过, 着) use a plain "(partícula...)" tag; this one instead embeds literal translations ("vamos a…; ¿verdad?"), which breaks that pattern and reads as two unrelated senses rather than one particle
别 is the prohibitive "don't (do that)!", distinct from plain negation 不 (which is already glossed simply "no"); bare "no" loses that and makes the two indistinguishable
encargado reads as "manager/person in charge", which overstates 服务员 (entry-level service staff — waiter, hotel attendant, clerk)
可以 is permission ("may"); plain "poder" is already used for 能 (h1 w072) and risks merging with 会/能, which this HSK set otherwise keeps distinct (know-how vs. ability vs. permission)
离 is a neutral distance/time reference ("X离Y近/远" = "X is near/far from Y"), not "far" by itself — "lejos de" wrongly bakes in "far", and it can be near just as easily (离这儿很近 = close to here, not far)
